messages:
Nora Lee: Quick design sync — mobile comp shows a "Canary paused" pill overlapping the timeline scrubber on 320px. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/canary-pause-compact.png

Kai - Eng: Yea that overlap causes tap issues. We shouldn't change DOM order for SR, so options: add timeline top padding, or make the pill a right-anchored toast inside the timeline header.

Priya Sharma: Prefer toast anchored to right of header so minimal vertical shift. For very narrow widths, toast should expand to full width and sit above header (no overlap).

Sam - PM: Copy choices: "Canary paused D traffic routed to stable" vs "Canary paused by system D view details". We need to show automation source when relevant. Thoughts?

Nora Lee: Keep primary short: "Canary paused". Secondary small line: "Traffic routed to stable D Paused automatically" when autoscaler did it.

Kai - Eng: Accessibility: urgent state should be aria-live="assertive". But that can interrupt users; maybe assertive only for safety-triggered pauses, polite otherwise. Also don't steal focus — provide a skip-to-undo link revealed on focus.`

a11y-bot: checklist: contrast >= 4.5:1 for 12px text, aria-live set, toast dismissible, skip link present, reduced-motion respected.

Priya Sharma: Visual: current pale yellow fails contrast on secondary. I'll try darker background (#FFD89A) and add a pause icon. Also add 12px top padding to timeline when toast overlays.

Kai - Eng: Interaction: Undo inline button should show quick confirm microdialog to avoid accidental rollforwards. For keyboard, make undo aria-label="Undo canary pause" and visible focus ring. Tab order: keep scrubber first; toast tabindex=-1; skip link moves focus to undo.

Sam - PM: Instrument: canary_pause_toast_shown, canary_undo_clicked, canary_undo_confirmed, layout_shift_score. Track Undo within 2 minutes.

Nora Lee: Motion: slide in from right, fallback to fade on reduced-motion; duration <=200ms. Make max-width 420px, full width under 360px.

Kai - Eng: Note: private consoles sometimes override media queries; will add JS feature-detect to set reduced-motion class.

Priya Sharma: I'll update Figma with right-anchored toast, darker swatch, icon, two-line copy, and small alt for <360px.

Sam - PM: Next: Priya uploads frames, Kai prototypes tabindex and undo flow, Nora adds QA checklist and tags infra for telemetry. Target: next sprint.

Nora Lee: Thanks team — will post updated frames by EOD. :thumbsup:
